notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch Note
notes.content:
Equipments' balance are fixed.

[h1]Balance[/h1]

[list]
[*] Heavy bullet's damage growth incresed. : +20% -> +40%
[*] Heavy bullet's damage reduction decreased. : -50% -> -30%
[*] Ricochet's damage growth increased. : +20% -> +40%
[*] Anger Manager's recharge speed increased. : 5/s -> 8/s
[*] Scythe of Reverberation's attack position is adjusted to be closer to the player.
[*] Scythe of Reverberation's attack range increased by 100%.
[/list]

tags.balance_change: [*] Scythe of Reverberation's attack position is adjusted to be closer to the player.
[*] Scythe of Reverberation's attack range increased by 100%.

notes.title: v1.0 Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0 Release on Jan 19th[/h1]

[Twinkle Hunter] is officially launching on January 19th after nearly a month of Early Access.
Thanks for everyone who have been insterested in the game during long time.

New contents is added on v1.0.

[h1]New contents[/h1]

[list]
[*] Many new members of Twinkle Thieves
[*] New Weaons, Talismans, and Rage Skills
[*] 20 achievements
[/list]

Technical fixes, difficulty and balance adjustments will continue beyond v1.0.

tags.feature: [*] Many new members of Twinkle Thieves
[*] New Weaons, Talismans, and Rage Skills
